global_versioning.rule: The application build is global. Classic/Market engine versions are component references, not the Administrator application version.

windows: Atlas Math Core / Math Core Métaux
operator_compositions: Target Top + Market Flow + Market + Math Core
Any subset can be reduced, hidden, detached or restored without stopping its business runtime.

window_contract.docked: native Classic/Mirror layout; exactly one persistent window handle per operational unit
window_contract.window_handle: five direct compact controls: ⠿ move, — reduce, □ detach/dock, ⤢ maximize/restore, × hide; visually reduced in 39.2.8 while semantics stay unchanged
window_contract.minimize: collapse the entire operational unit to one compact visible restore bar in its native location; + Restaurer then × at the far right; runtime continues
window_contract.hide: remove the entire operational unit from cockpit; recall through WINDOW DECK; runtime continues
window_contract.detach: move/use the original DOM presentation; never clone business content

math_core_contract.docked: Classic Math Core behavior preserved exactly
math_core_contract.detached: medium right-side instrument on first detach; preferred width about 42% of viewport, clamped 520-760 px
math_core_contract.native_modes: Dessus / Latéral / Réduire remain native Math Core controls

domain_contract.target: portal host follows Crypto/Metals native ribbon container
domain_contract.flow: portal host follows Crypto/Metals native ribbon container
domain_contract.market: portal host follows Crypto/Metals native market grid
domain_contract.math: same Math Core DOM and Classic placement logic preserved
